content.short: Nethermind Security is a blockchain research and software engineering company.
content.description: Nethermind Security delivers blockchain research and software engineering services, featuring thorough smart contract audits. An audit provides an independent review of contract code, highlights vulnerabilities and weaknesses, and outlines concrete improvements to strengthen safety, security, and proper function. By methodically examining code paths, data flows, and access controls, the team aims to help contracts perform as intended and minimize user risk. Audits emphasize clear findings, reproducible results, and actionable recommendations for developers.
